info.title: VideoOutput
info.description: Provides access to video output configuration. Apps can query and subscribe to video output resolution changes.

methods.name: VideoOutput.resolution
methods.summary: Get the current video output resolution.
methods.description: Returns the current HDMI output resolution of the device.

methods.name: VideoOutput.onResolutionChanged
methods.summary: Subscribe to video output resolution changes.
methods.description: Fired when the video output resolution changes.

params.name: listen
params.description: Pass true to subscribe; false to unsubscribe

VideoResolution.title: VideoResolution
VideoResolution.description: Video resolution output. The resolution in format WIDTHxHEIGHT.
